tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind the rail and panels. Text sits on it at dark 16.4:1, light 17.3:1 (text), dark 9.6:1, light 8.0:1 (text-muted).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, table body, rail, drawer. text dark 15.7:1, light 16.5:1, text-muted dark 9.2:1, light 7.6:1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, command palette, toasts, modals (always with shadow-popover or shadow-modal). In dark it is one step lighter than surface; in light it is white.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Log stream, diff and code panes: the one surface that is darker than its panel in both themes. text dark 16.4:1, light 15.7:1.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Resting fill of buttons, inputs, segmented controls. text-muted on it: dark 8.6:1, light 7.2:1.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a control; also hover of a table row when the row is a control.

tokens.name: control-active
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected fill of a control. text-muted on it: dark 7.3:1, light 6.4:1.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover background of a table row, list item or palette item.

tokens.name: row-selected
tokens.usage: Selected table row or the keyboard-focused palette item. Lime tint: it means "this is the one your keys act on". text on it: dark 14.3:1, light 15.8:1.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline between panels, table rows, sections. Decorative: it carries no meaning on its own, so it is not held to 3:1.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Hover border of a control and the divider between a row and a sticky header.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Border of inputs, checkboxes, outline buttons: any border that is the only mark of a control. On bg dark 3.9:1, light 3.5:1, on control dark 3.5:1, light 3.2:1 (3:1 floor).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers. On bg dark 16.4:1, light 17.3:1, on surface dark 15.7:1, light 16.5:1.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: column headers, labels, timestamps. On bg dark 9.6:1, light 8.0:1, on surface dark 9.2:1, light 7.6:1, on control-active dark 7.3:1, light 6.4:1.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, units, hints. Passes 4.5:1 on bg and surface only (dark 5.5:1, light 5.2:1 on surface), not on control fills; never use it for a value an operator must read.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls and their labels. Exempt from contrast (WCAG 1.4.3); pair with the disabled attribute, never alone.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a modal, the command palette and the phone sheet.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the "needs you" marker. Text on it is on-accent: dark 11.7:1, light 12.3:1.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the solid accent. on-accent on it: dark 13.6:1, light 10.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet background of a accent pill, banner or row marker. accent-text on it: dark 11.9:1, light 6.8:1; text on it: dark 14.3:1, light 15.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-border
tokens.usage: Border of a accent pill or banner (decorative; the word and glyph carry the meaning).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Text and glyph in the accent tone. On bg dark 13.6:1, light 7.5:1, on surface dark 13.0:1, light 7.1:1, on accent-subtle dark 11.9:1, light 6.8:1.

tokens.name: accent-mark
tokens.usage: Dots, progress fills, sparkline strokes, graph edges in the accent tone: the non-text mark. On surface dark 11.5:1, light 3.8:1 (3:1 floor). Light theme uses step 8 because the solid is too pale to mark on white.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the solid accent (and accent-hover). Dark ink on a light solid, near-white on a deep solid; dark 11.7:1, light 12.3:1 on solid, dark 13.6:1, light 10.8:1 on hover.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Solid success fill (rare: the merged glyph, a completed bar). Text on it is on-ok: dark 8.0:1, light 4.7:1.

tokens.name: ok-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the solid ok. on-ok on it: dark 9.2:1, light 5.5:1.

tokens.name: ok-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet background of a ok pill, banner or row marker. ok-text on it: dark 10.1:1, light 6.9:1; text on it: dark 14.3:1, light 15.6:1.

tokens.name: ok-border
tokens.usage: Border of a ok pill or banner (decorative; the word and glyph carry the meaning).

tokens.name: ok-text
tokens.usage: Text and glyph in the ok tone. On bg dark 11.6:1, light 7.6:1, on surface dark 11.1:1, light 7.3:1, on ok-subtle dark 10.1:1, light 6.9:1.

tokens.name: ok-mark
tokens.usage: Dots, progress fills, sparkline strokes, graph edges in the ok tone: the non-text mark. On surface dark 7.8:1, light 4.5:1 (3:1 floor).

tokens.name: on-ok
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the solid ok (and ok-hover). Dark ink on a light solid, near-white on a deep solid; dark 8.0:1, light 4.7:1 on solid, dark 9.2:1, light 5.5:1 on hover.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Solid caution fill (rare). Text on it is on-warn: dark 9.5:1, light 9.8:1.

tokens.name: warn-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the solid warn. on-warn on it: dark 10.9:1, light 8.5:1.

tokens.name: warn-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet background of a warn pill, banner or row marker. warn-text on it: dark 10.1:1, light 6.2:1; text on it: dark 14.3:1, light 15.5:1.

tokens.name: warn-border
tokens.usage: Border of a warn pill or banner (decorative; the word and glyph carry the meaning).

tokens.name: warn-text
tokens.usage: Text and glyph in the warn tone. On bg dark 11.6:1, light 6.9:1, on surface dark 11.0:1, light 6.6:1, on warn-subtle dark 10.1:1, light 6.2:1.

tokens.name: warn-mark
tokens.usage: Dots, progress fills, sparkline strokes, graph edges in the warn tone: the non-text mark. On surface dark 9.3:1, light 3.7:1 (3:1 floor). Light theme uses step 8 because the solid is too pale to mark on white.

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the solid warn (and warn-hover). Dark ink on a light solid, near-white on a deep solid; dark 9.5:1, light 9.8:1 on solid, dark 10.9:1, light 8.5:1 on hover.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill (Cancel batch, Halt). Text on it is on-danger: dark 4.7:1, light 5.2:1.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the solid danger. on-danger on it: dark 5.9:1, light 6.2:1.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet background of a danger pill, banner or row marker. danger-text on it: dark 8.4:1, light 6.5:1; text on it: dark 14.5:1, light 15.4:1.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of a danger pill or banner (decorative; the word and glyph carry the meaning).

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Text and glyph in the danger tone. On bg dark 9.5:1, light 7.3:1, on surface dark 9.1:1, light 7.0:1, on danger-subtle dark 8.4:1, light 6.5:1.

tokens.name: danger-mark
tokens.usage: Dots, progress fills, sparkline strokes, graph edges in the danger tone: the non-text mark. On surface dark 3.8:1, light 5.1:1 (3:1 floor).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the solid danger (and danger-hover). Dark ink on a light solid, near-white on a deep solid; dark 4.7:1, light 5.2:1 on solid, dark 5.9:1, light 6.2:1 on hover.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Solid live fill (running bar). Text on it is on-info: dark 4.6:1, light 4.8:1.

tokens.name: info-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the solid info. on-info on it: dark 5.6:1, light 5.7:1.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Quiet background of a info pill, banner or row marker. info-text on it: dark 8.7:1, light 6.2:1; text on it: dark 14.3:1, light 15.5:1.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Border of a info pill or banner (decorative; the word and glyph carry the meaning).

tokens.name: info-text
tokens.usage: Text and glyph in the info tone. On bg dark 10.0:1, light 6.9:1, on surface dark 9.5:1, light 6.6:1, on info-subtle dark 8.7:1, light 6.2:1.

tokens.name: info-mark
tokens.usage: Dots, progress fills, sparkline strokes, graph edges in the info tone: the non-text mark. On surface dark 3.9:1, light 4.7:1 (3:1 floor).

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the solid info (and info-hover). Dark ink on a light solid, near-white on a deep solid; dark 4.6:1, light 4.8:1 on solid, dark 5.6:1, light 5.7:1 on hover.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2 px outline, 2 px offset, on every focusable element. Solid lime in dark, olive in light: dark 12.0:1, light 3.9:1 on bg, dark 10.7:1, light 3.6:1 on control.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Series 1 (blue) of a stacked or multi-line chart, in this order, for repository, account and size series. dark 7.4:1, light 4.6:1 on surface (3:1 floor). Pair every series with a legend label and a direct label or marker shape; hue alone never names a series.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps in dense lists, helper text, chart axes. Tabular numbers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Column headers, pill and badge text, form labels.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default: table cells, panel text, event descriptions. The dense base.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Row titles, key values, active tab.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead text, empty-state copy, drawer prose, desktop answer forms.
styles.sample: No batch is running. Start one from a template.

styles.name: body-touch
styles.usage: Phone body and every phone input (16 px stops the iOS zoom on focus).
styles.sample: Which database should the importer use?

styles.name: display
styles.usage: KPI numbers: spend today, sessions running.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Run ids, branch names, paths, log lines, diff.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Timestamps and offsets in event streams.

styles.name: mono-strong
styles.usage: Run id in a page header, the selected task id.

spacing.note: 4 px base. Gaps inside a dense row use space-1 and space-2; panel padding space-3 (desktop) or space-4 (phone); screen gutters space-4 (phone) or space-6 (desktop).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, pill padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between controls in a toolbar; table cell padding inline in compact density.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; table cell padding inline.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phone, screen gutter on phone, section gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in a grid.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Collapsed rail width; large empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Maximum single gap; never inside a table.

tokens.usage: Badge size S, inline code, diff gutter chips.

tokens.name: radius-4

tokens.name: radius-pill
